editorial_review_row.content: LiteFinance is an offshore broker scoring 6.0/10 from NAFT in 2026. Marshall Islands regulated — no Tier-1 licence. Operating since 2005 (21 years). $10 deposit, ECN from 0.0 pips, built-in social trading. No investor compensation. Withdrawal times up to 5 days. Best for traders in underserved regions needing accessible offshore trading with social copy features.
